education:0.en: Inside the Hall of First Steps, Master Qingwu unrolled a scroll older than memory. 'Your *education* begins not with sword or flame,' she said quietly, 'but with the names of things.' Each name, she explained, was a seed. Plant it well, and it would grow into power.
education:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊在初阶殿内告诉弟子，真正的____从认识万物之名开始。
education:0.hook: One name on the scroll had been scratched out.
education:0.line: 'Your *education* begins not with sword or flame, but with the names of things.'

scientist:0.en: Shen Wujiu spread his notes across the stone table, measuring each herb with careful eyes. 'In this sect,' he said, 'a good *scientist* of spiritual plants knows their weight, their colour, and their silence.' He marked a number, then paused — one herb had no weight at all.
scientist:0.cnHint: 申无咎像研究自然的____一样，仔细测量每一株灵草的重量。
scientist:0.hook: The weightless herb cast a shadow it should not have.
scientist:0.line: 'A good *scientist* of spiritual plants knows their weight, their colour, and their silence.'

physical:0.en: Master Qingwu pressed one finger to the cold training-room wall. 'The word is not enough,' she warned. 'You must feel its *physical* weight in your chest before you speak it aloud.' I placed my hand beside hers and felt something press back — warm, steady, and very alive.
physical:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊要求弟子在开口念词之前，先感受它____上的重量。
physical:0.line: 'Feel its *physical* weight in your chest before you speak it aloud.'

quality:0.en: Xiaoxing held the small jade vial to the light, tilting it left, then right. 'The *quality* of a healing word depends on how purely you believe it,' she said softly. Her own word shone silver; mine was a dull grey. She did not laugh, but she did not look away either.
quality:0.cnHint: 小星告诉我，一个疗愈词语的____取决于信念是否纯粹。
quality:0.hook: My grey word slowly turned darker.
quality:0.line: 'The *quality* of a healing word depends on how purely you believe it.'

habit:0.en: Every dawn before the bell, Shen Wujiu stood alone in the inner study, repeating the same three words until they were smooth as river stone. 'A good *habit* is armour,' he told me when I found him there, 'and armour worn daily never rusts.' He handed me the list.
habit:0.cnHint: 申无咎每天清晨都重复同样的三个词，他说好____是铠甲。
habit:0.hook: My name was already written at the bottom of the list.
habit:0.line: 'A good *habit* is armour, and armour worn daily never rusts.'

sound:0.en: We gathered in the dim preparation room, and Master Qingwu asked us to close our eyes. 'Listen,' she whispered. A single clear *sound* rose from the centre of the room — not a bell, not a voice, but something between the two. It carried a word none of us yet knew.
sound:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊让我们闭眼倾听，房间中央升起一个奇异的____。
sound:0.hook: The unknown word settled in my throat like a question.
sound:0.line: 'Listen — that *sound* carries a word you have not yet earned.'

average:0.en: Shen Wujiu lined up our practice tablets and counted our errors in silence. 'The *average* disciple makes forty mistakes before mastering one word,' he said at last, setting my tablet aside from the rest. I had made thirty-nine. He did not smile, but his brush paused over my name.
average:0.cnHint: 申无咎统计了弟子们的失误次数，提到____水平是四十次错误。
average:0.hook: He set my tablet apart without explanation.
average:0.line: 'The *average* disciple makes forty mistakes before mastering one word.'

body:0.en: In the quiet recovery room, Xiaoxing sat beside me after the failed recitation. 'The word must travel through your whole *body*,' she said, tracing a slow line from my throat to my hands, 'not only through your mouth.' Outside, the mountain clouds parted for just a moment, then closed again.
body:0.cnHint: 小星说，词语必须穿越整个____，而不只是从口中说出。
body:0.hook: The clouds closing again felt like a warning.
body:0.line: 'The word must travel through your whole *body*, not only your mouth.'

compare:0.en: Inside the Hall of Words, stone tablets lined every wall, each carved with a different spiritual formula. Master Qingwu set two scrolls before me. 'Read both before you speak,' she said. I tried to *compare* them, but the characters on the second scroll shifted like smoke, refusing to hold still.
compare:0.cnHint: 在文字殿中，师尊要求我____两卷功法，但其中一卷的字迹诡异地不断变动。
compare:0.hook: The second scroll had no author, and its edges were still warm.
compare:0.line: '*Compare* the two formulas carefully — one of them was never meant to be read.'

past:0.en: The Hall of Records held every disciple's name since the Sect was founded. I traced the columns with one finger, searching for my family's mark. The archivist, old and silent, finally said: 'The *past* does not always welcome those who come looking.' Outside, a single cloud rose from below and covered the sun.
past:0.cnHint: 在档案殿查阅宗门历史时，档案守者提醒我，____并不总是欢迎寻访者。
past:0.hook: My family name appeared once — then the ink faded before my eyes.
past:0.line: 'The *past* keeps its own doors, and not all of them open from your side.'

suffer:0.en: The training room smelled of cedar and old ink. Shen Wujiu watched me attempt the Breathing Word for the third time. My hands shook, my chest ached, but I would not stop. 'Those who *suffer* through the first ten tries,' he said quietly, 'are the ones who later fly the highest.' A candle flame bent toward me without any wind.
suffer:0.cnHint: 师兄观察我在修炼室中反复尝试吐纳法诀，告诉我____过最初十次失败的人，终会飞得最高。
suffer:0.hook: The candle had not moved like that for any disciple before me.
suffer:0.line: 'You must *suffer* through the first ten attempts — there is no other path forward.'

almost:0.en: I held the Stillness Glyph in my mind for what felt like an hour. The room grew quiet, the air thickened with pale light, and I *almost* felt the word take root in my breath — then a low bell rang somewhere deep in the mountain, and the light scattered like startled birds.
almost:0.cnHint: 我在修炼室内凝神静字，____就要成功时，山腹深处忽然传来一声低沉的钟鸣。
almost:0.hook: No one had rung that bell in three hundred years.
almost:0.line: 'You were *almost* there — whatever broke your focus was not an accident.'

especially:0.en: Master Qingwu placed seven herb-words on the table and told me to memorize their order. All were difficult, but one glowed faintly gold and resisted my memory *especially* — as though it did not want to be held inside an untested mind. By evening I could recite six. The golden word remained just out of reach.
especially:0.cnHint: 师尊让我记忆七个草药灵字，其中一个____难以记住，好像不愿停留在未经考验的心智里。
especially:0.hook: The golden word appeared, uninvited, in my dream that night.
especially:0.line: 'This one is *especially* dangerous to learn in the wrong order — start from the root, not the crown.'

publish:0.en: Deep in the archive hall, I found a cracked tablet whose text had been deliberately chipped away. The archivist said the elders once chose to *publish* only half of the Cloud Formula, sealing the rest in stone. What remained visible was enough to calm storms. What was hidden, she did not say.
publish:0.cnHint: 档案馆的守者说，长老们曾决定只____云诀的一半，将其余部分封存在石碑之中。
publish:0.hook: The sealed half of the tablet had begun, very slowly, to glow.
publish:0.line: 'They chose to *publish* only what the world was ready to receive — the rest remains sealed.'

activity:0.en: Xiaoxing spread a wide paper across the floor of the practice room and began marking the day's events in small, careful strokes. 'Every *activity* in this hall leaves a trace in the air,' she explained, circling one mark twice. 'This one here — I do not recognise it, and it was made after midnight.'
activity:0.cnHint: 师妹在修炼室内记录每日的____痕迹，发现其中有一处是她无法辨认的，且发生在子夜之后。
activity:0.hook: The circled mark was still faintly warm to the touch.
activity:0.line: 'Every *activity* in this room leaves a record — someone practiced here who should not have.'

science:0.en: Shen Wujiu sat across from me with an old text open on his knees. 'People outside these mountains call what we do superstition,' he said, 'but it is a *science* — every word, every breath, every root has its rule and its reason.' He closed the book. Somewhere below us, the sea of clouds split open in a perfect circle.
science:0.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，外界的人误以为修炼是迷信，但它其实是一门____——每一个字、每一次呼吸都有其规律。
science:0.hook: Nothing natural could split clouds into a circle so precise.
science:0.line: 'What we practice here is a *science* — learn its rules before you trust your instinct.'

receive:0.en: Inside the Archive Hall, rows of jade slips glowed faintly on their shelves. I knelt before Master Qingwu as she placed a sealed slip in my hands. 'You *receive* this formula only when your heart is still,' she said. The characters within it pulsed like a living breath.
receive:0.cnHint: 在藏经阁中，我从师尊手中____了一枚封印玉简。
receive:0.hook: But the seal cracked before I could even read the first word.
receive:0.line: 'You *receive* this formula only when your heart is still.'

encourage:0.en: Shen Wujiu found me slumped against a pillar in the training hall, my brush dry and my spirit colder. He set a warm cup of herb tea beside me without a word. Then he spoke softly to *encourage* me, saying that every great disciple had once sat in that same defeated spot.
encourage:0.cnHint: 师兄用一句话来____我，让我重新提起了笔。
encourage:0.hook: Behind him, my unfinished formula began to glow on its own.
encourage:0.line: 'I only want to *encourage* you — that empty page is not your enemy.'

travel:0.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a long map across the stone table. The ink lines showed paths of spiritual wind above the Cloud Sea. 'Your *travel* through the inner peaks will begin at dawn,' she said. Xiaoxing traced one route with a careful finger, her sleeve brushing mine.
travel:0.cnHint: 师尊在室内为我们规划____路线，指向云海深处的内峰。
travel:0.hook: One path on the map had no name, only a small red mark.
travel:0.line: 'Your *travel* through the inner peaks will begin at dawn.'

strong:0.en: The testing stone in the examination hall was said to record a disciple's true spirit weight. I pressed my palms flat against its cool surface. The pulse that returned was *strong*, steadier than I had expected, and the elder watching it raised one eyebrow without comment.
strong:0.cnHint: 测试灵石感应到我的灵力出奇地____，监考长老神色微动。
strong:0.hook: A thin crack appeared in the stone where my hands had rested.
strong:0.line: 'The pulse is *strong* — steadier than any newcomer I have seen.'

chance:0.en: Xiaoxing whispered to me in the corridor outside the pill room, her eyes bright with urgency. A rare study session with Master Qingwu had opened at midnight, and only one seat remained. 'This is your *chance*,' she said, pressing the entry token firmly into my palm.
chance:0.cnHint: 师妹告诉我，这是一个难得的____，将入场令牌交到了我手中。
chance:0.hook: The token was warm, as if someone had only just let it go.
chance:0.line: 'This is your *chance* — take the token before the bell rings.'

solve:0.en: The riddle carved above the inner gate had stopped three senior disciples for seven days. I sat alone in the lamp-lit antechamber, reading it once more. When I finally let my mind go quiet, the pattern surfaced on its own. I could *solve* it because I had stopped forcing an answer.
solve:0.cnHint: 我独自在门廊静思，终于____了困扰师兄们多日的铭文谜题。
solve:0.hook: The gate did not open — it simply was no longer there.
solve:0.line: 'To *solve* it, you must first agree to not know the answer.'

quite:0.en: The inner library was smaller than the rumours had claimed. Still, the quality of what lined its walls was *quite* unlike anything I had seen in the outer hall — each jade slip sealed with a sigil that shimmered and then hid itself when my gaze lingered too long.
quite:0.cnHint: 内藏阁的藏品与外堂____不同，每枚玉简的印记都会躲避目光。
quite:0.hook: One slip, set apart on a high shelf, had no sigil at all.
quite:0.line: 'These texts are *quite* beyond what the outer hall will ever hold.'

technology:0.en: Shen Wujiu laid out a set of tools on the workbench and explained that the Sect had developed a new *technology* for binding formulas into silk without using a brush. Master Qingwu watched from the doorway, her expression unreadable. The first sheet of silk caught fire at the fourth word.
technology:0.cnHint: 师兄展示了宗门研发的新____，尝试将法诀直接刻入绢帛。
technology:0.hook: The ash on the bench spelled out a warning none of us had written.
technology:0.line: 'This *technology* lets us bind any formula without lifting a brush.'

contribute:0.en: Inside the Hall of Words, Master Qingwu placed an ancient scroll on the stone table. 'Each disciple must *contribute* one herb-phrase to the sect's healing record,' she said. I pressed my palm to the page and breathed out the word I had gathered at dawn. The ink rose like green smoke and held its shape.
contribute:0.cnHint: 在文字殿内，师尊要求每位弟子向门派的治愈典籍____一个草药字诀。
contribute:0.hook: But the smoke curled inward, as if something beneath the page had begun to breathe.
contribute:0.line: 'Every disciple must *contribute* one living phrase before the season turns.'

share:0.en: Shen Wujiu spread three scrolls across the low table and handed me one without a word. 'This is your *share* of the formation text,' he said quietly. 'Learn it before the bell rings.' The characters shifted under my eyes, each one warm as a coal. Outside, the clouds below the mountain turned an unusual shade of red.
share:0.cnHint: 师兄将阵法典籍分成几份，把属于我的那____推了过来。
share:0.hook: The red deepened, and somewhere far below, a bell rang that no one had struck.
share:0.line: 'Take your *share* of the text and do not let it cool before you read it.'

decade:0.en: The iron record on the wall listed every disciple who had passed the indoor trial. Master Qingwu traced one name with her finger. 'This one trained for a *decade* before the words obeyed her,' she said softly. I counted the marks beside my own name: seven days. The candle between us flickered without any wind.
decade:0.cnHint: 师尊指着铁壁上的记录，说那位师姐苦练了____才让字诀听命于她。
decade:0.hook: The candle went out, and in the dark the iron marks began to glow.
decade:0.line: 'She gave a full *decade* to this hall before she ever left it.'

kind:0.en: Xiaoxing sorted the word-vials on the shelf by color, humming to herself. 'There is only one *kind* of phrase that can seal a wound this deep,' she told me, lifting a vial of pale silver. I watched her hands, sure and calm. A thin crack appeared in the stone floor, running straight toward my feet.
kind:0.cnHint: 师妹在整理字诀瓶时说，只有某一____的字诀才能封住那么深的伤口。
kind:0.hook: The crack stopped at my toe and then, slowly, began to widen.
kind:0.line: 'This is the only *kind* of phrase that works on a wound older than stone.'

across:0.en: The proving hall was long and narrow. Master Qingwu stood at the far end and held up a single character made of light. 'Carry the word *across* the room without letting it dim,' she said. I walked. With each step the character shrank. By the halfway point it was no larger than a firefly, and I was afraid.
across:0.cnHint: 师尊要求我把那个发光的字诀____整个大殿，不能让它熄灭。
across:0.hook: Three steps from the far wall the light went out entirely, yet Master Qingwu was smiling.
across:0.line: 'Bring the living word *across* the full length of the hall — then we will talk.'

factor:0.en: Shen Wujiu drew a diagram of the five-word formation on the slate board. 'Wind direction is the key *factor*,' he said, tapping the center point. 'Ignore it and the whole structure collapses.' I copied the diagram carefully. When I finished, every line I had drawn began to glow a color the diagram had never shown.
factor:0.cnHint: 师兄在讲解五字阵法时说，风向是决定阵法成败的关键____。
factor:0.hook: The new color pulsed once, twice, and then spread toward the edge of the board.
factor:0.line: 'Wind is the single *factor* that decides whether this formation stands or falls.'

condition:0.en: The healing chamber smelled of pine and old paper. Master Qingwu examined my hands under a lamp. 'The *condition* of your word-roots is still weak,' she said, not unkindly. 'You must rest them in silence for one full night before the test.' I nodded, but when I looked at my palms I saw the lines there had changed shape.
condition:0.cnHint: 师尊检查我的双手后说，我字根的____还太虚弱，需要静养一夜才能参加考核。
condition:0.hook: The new lines on my palms matched exactly the diagram Shen Wujiu had drawn on the slate.
condition:0.line: 'The *condition* of your word-roots tells me you have not slept in three days.'

effort:0.en: I had tried the binding phrase forty times. Shen Wujiu watched without speaking until the fortieth failure faded from the air. Then he said, 'Your *effort* is clear, but effort without stillness is just noise.' He placed one finger on my wrist and the room went quiet. On the fifty-first try the phrase held, bright and unmoving.
effort:0.cnHint: 师兄看着我一次次失败后说，我的____显而易见，但没有静心的努力只是噪音。
effort:0.hook: The held phrase cast a shadow that pointed toward the sealed door at the hall's north end.
effort:0.line: 'Your *effort* is real — now let go of it, and the word will finally obey you.'

personal:0.en: Master Qingwu set a blank scroll before each of us. 'This trial is *personal*,' she said quietly. 'No two paths through the Cloud Sea are the same.' I pressed my brush to the page and felt the mountain tremble beneath my feet, as if it too were waiting to learn who I was.
personal:0.cnHint: 师尊说，这次试炼是____的，每位弟子的修行之路各不相同。
personal:0.hook: At the scroll's edge, a single black feather appeared from nowhere.
personal:0.line: 'This trial is *personal* — your words must come from within, not from mine.'

rather:0.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a jar of ink that smelled of pine and cold rain. I had expected bright cinnabar, but this was dark, almost grey. 'Use this *rather* than the red,' he said. 'Red calls fire. Grey calls patience.' I dipped my brush and the room grew very still.
rather:0.cnHint: 师兄让我用灰色墨水____用红色，说灰色能唤来耐心。
rather:0.hook: The grey ink spread into a shape no brush stroke could explain.
rather:0.line: 'Use this one *rather* than the red — trust me on that.'

instead:0.en: I raised my hand to speak the word 'rise,' hoping to lift the training stone. Nothing moved. Master Qingwu watched. *Instead* of trying again with force, I whispered the word the way one whispers to a sleeping child. The stone drifted upward, slow as morning fog.
instead:0.cnHint: 我没有用力再试，____轻声低语，石头慢慢升起。
instead:0.hook: A thin crack ran across the ceiling, spreading in perfect silence.
instead:0.line: 'Try stillness *instead* — the word hears your mood, not just your voice.'

performance:0.en: Xiaoxing finished her recitation first. Her *performance* was clean and bright: each word landed like a pebble dropped into still water, sending rings outward to the walls. Master Qingwu said nothing, but she traced one ring with her finger as it faded, and her eyes were thoughtful.
performance:0.cnHint: 师妹的____干净而明亮，每个字都像石子落入静水，荡起涟漪。
performance:0.hook: The last ripple did not fade — it darkened and held its shape.
performance:0.line: 'Her *performance* today reminded me how much the words love a calm heart.'

percent:0.en: 'Eighty *percent* of disciples fail this room in their first month,' Shen Wujiu said, leaning against the door frame with his arms crossed. 'Not because the words are hard. Because they are afraid to mean them.' I looked at my blank scroll and decided, quietly, to mean every word I wrote.
percent:0.cnHint: 师兄说，八十____的弟子第一个月都会在这间屋里失败，不是因为词语难，而是不敢真心。
percent:0.hook: Outside, a cloud the colour of ink pressed against the window glass.
percent:0.line: 'Eighty *percent* fail here — and every one of them stopped trusting themselves.'

achieve:0.en: Master Qingwu asked what I hoped to *achieve* by the end of the season. I said I wanted to write a word strong enough to hold a bridge of cloud. She smiled — not the warm kind, but the kind that means the road is longer than you think. Then she handed me a brush with a single white hair.
achieve:0.cnHint: 师尊问我这一季希望____什么，我说想写出能支撑云桥的字。
achieve:0.hook: The white hair in the brush began to glow before I had written a single stroke.
achieve:0.line: 'Tell me what you wish to *achieve*, and I will show you how far the path truly goes.'

challenge:0.en: The inner door of the hall bore a bronze plaque: 'Enter only if you accept the *challenge* of silence.' Shen Wujiu said that once you stepped through, no spoken word was allowed — only written ones. I pressed my palm to the cold door and felt the mountain hold its breath with me.
challenge:0.cnHint: 大厅内门上写着，只有接受____才能入内；进门后，只许写字，不许开口。
challenge:0.hook: The door swung open on its own before my hand could push.
challenge:0.line: 'The *challenge* inside is not the silence — it is hearing yourself within it.'

power:0.en: The training stone was said to measure a disciple's spiritual *power* by how long a written word could make it float. Mine held it up for three full breaths. Not long — but Xiaoxing touched my shoulder and said three breaths was two more than she had managed on her own first day.
power:0.cnHint: 训练石用来测量弟子的灵____，我写的字让它悬浮了三次呼吸。
power:0.hook: On the fourth breath, the stone rose again — though my brush was already still.
power:0.line: 'Even a small *power*, used with honesty, leaves a mark the stone remembers.'

key:0.en: The testing hall smelled of old wood and cold stone. Master Qingwu placed a small carved tablet on the stand before me. 'Every formula has a *key*,' she said, 'one word that unlocks its power. Find it, and the rest will follow.' I studied the marks, searching for the one word that held everything else together.
key:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊告诉我，每个法诀都有一个____，找到它，其余的自然应和。
key:0.hook: Behind the tablet, one carved mark had begun to glow on its own.
key:0.line: 'The *key* to this formula is the word you fear most.'

issue:0.en: Shen Wujiu spread three open scrolls across the hall floor, each one a copy of the sect's weekly word record. 'The real *issue*,' he said quietly, 'is that a page is missing from every single one.' I counted the gaps myself. Whatever had been written there, someone had taken great care to remove it.
issue:0.cnHint: 沈无咎发现每份周报都缺失了同一页，这个____让人不安。
issue:0.hook: The torn edges of all three scrolls still carried the same faint scent of ash.
issue:0.line: 'The *issue* is not what was written, but who erased it.'

against:0.en: I pressed my back *against* the cold stone pillar and held my breath. The testing flame moved slowly around the hall, drawn to any word spoken aloud. Xiaoxing had warned me: speak too soon and the flame reads fear, not skill. I waited, feeling the stone solid behind me, and steadied my voice.
against:0.cnHint: 我把背靠____石柱，等待试剑台上的测试之火平息。
against:0.hook: The flame paused directly in front of my pillar and did not move on.
against:0.line: 'Lean *against* nothing — stand in your own strength.'

matter:0.en: 'Does the order of words *matter*?' I asked, arranging the three herb-names on the practice slate. Shen Wujiu looked up from his own work without smiling. 'In cooking, perhaps not,' he said. 'In a healing formula, the wrong order can turn a cure into a wound.' I rearranged the slate with much greater care.
matter:0.cnHint: 我问沈无咎字词的顺序是否____，他的回答让我重新认真排列了石板上的字。
matter:0.hook: When I set the last word in place, the slate cracked cleanly down the middle.
matter:0.line: 'Order will always *matter* when the words carry power.'

raise:0.en: Master Qingwu asked us each to *raise* one word into the air using only breath and focus. Most disciples lifted common words — wind, stone, fire. When my turn came, the word I chose rose slowly, then kept climbing past the rafters, past the high windows, until it was a bright point above the testing hall.
raise:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊要我们用气息____一个字，我选的那个字升得比所有人都高。
raise:0.hook: No word had ever passed the high window before, not in any record the sect kept.
raise:0.line: '*Raise* the word gently — force will only shatter it.'

option:0.en: Xiaoxing laid two word-stones in my palm. 'You have one *option* left,' she said, her voice low and steady. 'The first stone seals the gap in the hall's barrier. The second restores your own strength. You cannot use both.' I looked at the cracked wall, then at my trembling hand, and made my choice.
option:0.cnHint: 小星告诉我只剩一个____：修补裂缝或恢复自身，两者只能择其一。
option:0.hook: As I set the chosen stone down, the other one turned cold and dark.
option:0.line: 'There is only one *option* that does not cost the sect.'

society:0.en: The inner hall held portraits of every sect leader since the Cloud Sea *society* was first formed, long before the mountains learned to float. Master Qingwu stood beneath the oldest portrait and said nothing for a long time. I understood then that the words we studied were not rules — they were a living thread connecting every disciple across centuries.
society:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊站在画像下，让我明白这个____的每一代弟子都通过字诀相连。
society:0.hook: One portrait near the end of the row had no face — only a faint outline in the paint.
society:0.line: 'This *society* was built on words long before it was built on stone.'

whole:0.en: I had learned each part of the formula separately over many weeks: the opening breath, the root word, the closing seal. Tonight Master Qingwu asked me to speak the *whole* thing without pause. My voice moved through all three parts in one long, unbroken line. For a moment the air in the hall went perfectly still.
whole:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊要我完整念出____套法诀，不能停顿，我做到了，大厅的空气随之凝住。
whole:0.hook: In that stillness, something above the hall answered with a single deep tone.
whole:0.line: 'Only the *whole* formula can open what a part cannot touch.'

nearly:0.en: Inside the Hall of Tested Blades, I stood before the stone pillar and pressed my palm against its surface. The spiritual energy rose too fast. I *nearly* lost control, and the whole pillar cracked from base to top. Shen Wujiu pulled me back just before the ceiling groaned.
nearly:0.cnHint: 我在试剑台内按掌石柱，能量失控，____酿成大祸。
nearly:0.hook: A thin black line spread upward through the stone, still growing.
nearly:0.line: 'You *nearly* shattered the whole hall just now,' said Shen Wujiu.

wrong:0.en: Master Qingwu circled the cracked pillar slowly, her robe brushing the dust. She pointed to the mark my palm had left. 'Something is *wrong* with the flow here,' she said quietly. The groove was supposed to curve left, but mine had split straight down the middle.
wrong:0.cnHint: 师尊检视我留下的掌印，发现方向____。
wrong:0.hook: She did not look angry — and that felt worse.
wrong:0.line: 'The direction is *wrong*,' Master Qingwu said, almost to herself.

variety:0.en: Along the inner wall of the hall hung a *variety* of practice swords — short blades, long ones, curved ones, and one shaped like a river reed. Xiaoxing told me each shape matched a different spiritual root. I had not expected so many paths to the same sky.
variety:0.cnHint: 试剑台墙上挂着各种____的练习剑，小星为我一一讲解。
variety:0.hook: One sword at the far end had no name tag at all.
variety:0.line: 'There is a great *variety* here — choose the one that calls to you,' said Xiaoxing.

clear:0.en: The testing smoke filled the room when I drew the reed-shaped blade. Everyone watched it swirl. Slowly the smoke settled into a single clean column of white, and the shape it made was *clear* — a mountain peak with clouds below. Shen Wujiu let out a long breath.
clear:0.cnHint: 试剑时烟雾凝成图形，山峰的轮廓____可见。
clear:0.hook: But the peak in the smoke had two summits, not one.
clear:0.line: 'Now the path ahead is *clear* to all of us,' Shen Wujiu said softly.

gain:0.en: Master Qingwu set a small jade counter on the table after my test. Each time a disciple survived a full circuit of the hall's pressure field, the counter rose by one. Today mine rose three times. 'This is no small *gain*,' she said, 'for a disciple of one month.'
gain:0.cnHint: 师尊用玉石计数器记录我今日的____，连她也感到意外。
gain:0.hook: The counter rose a fourth time on its own, then stopped.
gain:0.line: 'Three steps in one morning — that is a real *gain*,' said Master Qingwu.

maybe:0.en: Xiaoxing sat beside me while I rested on the cool floor of the hall. She handed me a cup of water and looked at the cracked pillar with wide eyes. '*Maybe* the pillar held a seal we did not know about,' she whispered. No one had told us what was stored inside stone this old.
maybe:0.cnHint: 小星轻声猜测，石柱内____封印着什么不为人知的东西。
maybe:0.hook: A faint hum came from the crack, steady and low.
maybe:0.line: '*Maybe* we should tell Master Qingwu before night falls,' Xiaoxing said.

huge:0.en: When Shen Wujiu demonstrated the hall's pressure field at full strength, the air bent like water. A *huge* wave of invisible force rolled outward from the centre stone. Every candle in the hall blew out at once. I pressed my feet against the floor and held on.
huge:0.cnHint: 师兄开启试炼压力场，一股____的无形力量向四周涌来。
huge:0.hook: When the candles relit themselves, they burned a cold blue.
huge:0.line: 'The pressure is *huge* today — keep your feet wide,' Shen Wujiu warned.

diet:0.en: After the test, Master Qingwu handed me a folded paper. It listed every herb I was to eat that week — bitter root in the morning, cloud-moss at noon, nothing heavy at night. 'A disciple's *diet* shapes the spirit as much as practice does,' she said, and left no room for argument.
diet:0.cnHint: 师尊给了我一张本周的____清单，说饮食与修炼同等重要。
diet:0.hook: The last herb on the list had no name, only a small red mark.
diet:0.line: 'Follow this *diet* without skipping a single item,' said Master Qingwu.

animal:0.en: Inside the Sect's herb library, I studied a scroll showing creatures that carried seeds across distant peaks. Each *animal* in the painting moved through mist with quiet purpose, as if delivering medicine to those in need. Master Qingwu watched from the doorway, saying nothing, only nodding once.
animal:0.cnHint: 在典籍阁中，我翻阅描绘灵兽传播草药的古卷，师尊静立门口注视着我。
animal:0.hook: The painted creature's eyes slowly turned to watch me.
animal:0.line: 'Every *animal* on this scroll has served the Sect without being asked,' said Master Qingwu.

goal:0.en: Shen Wujiu spread a map of the floating peaks across the low table and pressed one finger to its centre. 'Our *goal* is the highest platform,' he said quietly. Below us, clouds moved like slow breath. I copied the route onto my own paper, hand steady, heart anything but.
goal:0.cnHint: 师兄在室内摊开地图，向我说明此次登台的____所在。
goal:0.hook: The route passed directly through a peak marked with a warning seal.
goal:0.line: 'Our *goal* is the platform where the first disciple once stood,' said Shen Wujiu.

adult:0.en: Master Qingwu set a heavy jade register before me and pointed to a column of names. Every *adult* in the Sect had signed it before their first trial on the platform above. My name waited at the bottom, the ink still wet and trembling at the edges like a held breath.
adult:0.cnHint: 师尊展示门派名册，每位____弟子在登上试剑台前都曾在此留名。
adult:0.hook: One name near the top had been carefully, completely erased.
adult:0.line: 'Every *adult* who walks this path must first understand its weight,' said Master Qingwu.

poor:0.en: Xiaoxing placed her practice sword on the table and frowned at its dull edge. 'The balance is *poor*,' she said, turning it slowly in the lamplight. I had no better words for my own blade. We sat together in that quiet room, two unprepared disciples waiting for morning.
poor:0.cnHint: 小星在室内检查练习剑，发现其平衡____，我们都为明日的考验感到担忧。
poor:0.hook: Outside the window, a bell rang once — one hour until dawn.
poor:0.line: 'A *poor* blade is still a blade; use it well,' said Shen Wujiu from the doorway.

price:0.en: The inner hall held a single shelf of rare word-herbs, each sealed in glass. Beside every jar hung a small tag stating its *price* — not in silver, but in years of study. I reached toward one jar, then pulled my hand back. Some costs, I was not yet ready to pay.
price:0.cnHint: 内堂陈列着珍稀灵草，每株旁边标注着以修行年数计算的____。
price:0.hook: The jar I almost touched began to glow faintly on its own.
price:0.line: 'The *price* of this herb is ten years of honest practice,' said Master Qingwu.

type:0.en: Shen Wujiu sorted the practice scrolls into three rows on the floor. 'Each *type* calls for a different stance,' he explained, tapping the first row. 'These demand stillness. These demand speed. These demand both.' I stared at the third row for a long time and chose one from it.
type:0.cnHint: 师兄将练习卷轴按____分类，向我讲解每种姿势的要领。
type:0.hook: The scroll I unrolled contained writing I had never seen before.
type:0.line: 'This *type* of form will test everything you have learned,' said Shen Wujiu.

sense:0.en: The preparation room smelled of cedar and old ink. I sat alone and tried to steady my breathing. Slowly, a *sense* of calm settled over me, the way mist settles in a valley just before dawn. It was not confidence, but it was enough to lift me from my seat.
sense:0.cnHint: 在准备室中静坐，我渐渐获得了一种____，使我能够平静面对即将到来的考验。
sense:0.hook: Then the candle flame bent sideways, though the air was still.
sense:0.line: 'Trust that *sense* of stillness — it has guided disciples for generations,' said Master Qingwu.

rate:0.en: On the inner wall of the archive room hung a wooden board. It showed the pass *rate* for each year's trial: most years, six in ten. This year's column was empty, waiting. Xiaoxing read the numbers aloud in a careful voice, then folded her hands and did not speak again.
rate:0.cnHint: 档案室墙上的木板记录着历年考验的通过____，今年的数字仍是空白。
rate:0.hook: Xiaoxing pointed to one year where the number read only two in ten.
rate:0.line: 'The *rate* has never been this uncertain,' Xiaoxing said softly, almost to herself.

action:0.en: Inside the Hall of Records, dust lay thick on the shelves. I had been standing still too long, afraid to choose a cultivation path. Master Qingwu set down her brush and looked at me steadily. 'Hesitation costs more than any mistake,' she said. Only *action* could open the first seal on the jade scroll.
action:0.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，光站着发呆没有用，必须做出____才能开启玉简封印。
action:0.hook: The seal began to glow before my fingers even touched it.
action:0.line: 'Every *action* you take here leaves a mark on the scroll.'

program:0.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a long paper across the low table in the inner study. It listed every trial on the testing stage in careful order: the flame step, the wind pillar, the mirror test. 'This is the *program* for tomorrow,' he said quietly. I read it twice, trying to remember every detail.
program:0.cnHint: 师兄把明天试剑台考核的____展开给我看，上面密密麻麻写满了项目。
program:0.hook: One item at the bottom of the list had been crossed out in red.
program:0.line: 'Study this *program* tonight — the last trial is the hardest.'

situation:0.en: I arrived late to the preparation room and found Xiaoxing kneeling before a cracked spirit stone. Her face was pale. The stone was supposed to power the stage wards for our group trial. I understood the *situation* at once: without it, none of us could enter safely. We had perhaps one hour.
situation:0.cnHint: 我走进准备室，立刻明白了眼前的____——灵石碎裂，试剑台的护阵快要失效了。
situation:0.hook: A faint crack spread across the second stone as we watched.
situation:0.line: 'You see the *situation* — we must find a replacement before dawn.'

order:0.en: Master Qingwu stood at the head of the preparation room and called our names one by one. She *ordered* us by the strength of our spiritual root: earth, water, fire, wind. I was placed last. Xiaoxing gave me a small, encouraging nod from her position near the front of the line.
order:0.cnHint: 师尊按照灵根属性把我们____好了站位顺序，我被排在了最后。
order:0.hook: Being last, I alone would face the stage with no one watching my back.
order:0.line: 'I have *ordered* the trials so each of you meets your own weakness.'

event:0.en: Word spread quickly through the inner hall: a disciple had touched the forbidden sword rack by accident and a cold light had burst from every blade at once. Such an *event* had not happened in forty years, the older disciples whispered. I wrote the time down in my notebook without knowing why.
event:0.cnHint: 内堂里流传着一件不寻常的____：有人误触禁剑架，所有剑刃同时迸发寒光。
event:0.hook: My notebook page turned cold and stiff the moment I finished writing.
event:0.line: 'An *event* like this is never an accident — remember that.'

account:0.en: Shen Wujiu had passed the testing stage three years before me. I found him in the side room and asked him to describe it. His *account* was short but careful: the stage tests not your strength but your honesty. 'It shows you exactly who you are,' he said, folding his hands, 'and it never lies.'
account:0.cnHint: 师兄给我讲述了他当年过试剑台的经历，他的____简短却让我心里发沉。
account:0.hook: He paused at the end, as if one part were still too hard to speak.
account:0.line: 'My *account* may not match yours — the stage changes for each person.'

deal:0.en: Xiaoxing had spent a great *deal* of time memorising the hand signs for the wind trial. Her fingers moved through each sign even while she waited in the preparation room, again and again, silent and focused. I watched her and felt ashamed of my own idle morning. I opened my scroll and began to study.
deal:0.cnHint: 小星花了大量的时间，也就是____的精力，在准备室里反复练习风试的手印。
deal:0.hook: At the thirty-third repetition her fingers stopped, trembling slightly.
deal:0.line: 'A great *deal* of effort means nothing if your mind is not still.'

degree:0.en: The testing stage was colder than I had expected. Each step forward raised the pressure by some small *degree*, invisible but real, like walking into deepening water. By the centre of the stage my breath came slowly and my thoughts felt heavy. Master Qingwu watched from the far end without expression, without moving.
degree:0.cnHint: 踏上试剑台，我感受到压力随着每一步以某种____在悄悄加深，呼吸也越来越沉。
degree:0.hook: At the very centre, the cold reached my chest and would not leave.
degree:0.line: 'The *degree* of pressure you feel tells me everything I need to know.'

mind:0.en: Inside the archive hall, shelves of jade slips rose to the ceiling. Master Qingwu placed one cool slip against my temple and said that every cultivator must first train the *mind* before the hand. I felt something stir behind my eyes, like a lamp being lit in a dark room.
mind:0.cnHint: 师尊在藏书阁里告诉我，修炼的根本在于锻炼____。
mind:0.hook: The lamp behind my eyes did not go out.
mind:0.line: 'Train your *mind* first, or the sword will only cut you.'

rise:0.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a long chart on the stone table. It mapped the *rise* of spiritual energy through the body's core channels, each peak marked with a red brushstroke. Shen Wujiu leaned over my shoulder and whispered that the steepest peak had never been reached by any disciple under forty.
rise:0.cnHint: 师尊展示了一幅图，描绘灵力在体内____的路径，其中最高峰从未有年轻弟子抵达。
rise:0.hook: My finger hovered over that unmarked peak.
rise:0.line: 'Study this *rise* carefully — it is where most disciples fall.'

prove:0.en: Xiaoxing spread her notes across the reading desk and challenged me to find her error. I worked through each line slowly. At last, the final formula did *prove* correct, yet a single character in the margin, half erased, told a different story about what she truly understood.
prove:0.cnHint: 小星邀我检查她的笔记，最终结果____正确，但页边有一个字令人生疑。
prove:0.hook: That half-erased character burned in my memory all night.
prove:0.line: 'Let the work *prove* itself — words alone mean nothing here.'

associate:0.en: In the herb room, Master Qingwu held up a silver-leafed sprig and asked me to *associate* its scent with the sound of the third bell. She said the mind learns fastest when two senses arrive together. I breathed in, the bell rang, and something clicked quietly into place.
associate:0.cnHint: 师尊要我将草药的气味与钟声____起来，以加速记忆。
associate:0.hook: When the fourth bell rang, my hand reached for the sprig before I thought.
associate:0.line: '*Associate* the scent with the bell and your memory will not fail.'

message:0.en: A folded paper slipped under the archive door just after midnight. I brought it to the candle. The *message* was three lines long and unsigned, written in a hand I did not know, yet every word matched a warning Master Qingwu had spoken to me only that morning.
message:0.cnHint: 深夜，一张纸从门缝滑入，____上的内容与师尊今晨的警告字字相符。
message:0.hook: No footstep sounded in the corridor outside.
message:0.line: 'Read the *message* twice — the meaning lives between the lines.'

development:0.en: Shen Wujiu spread last season's training records on the low table and traced a slow curve with his finger. He said that my *development* had been steady, which was rare, because most new disciples burned bright for a month and then stalled. Outside, the wind shifted, carrying the smell of rain.
development:0.cnHint: 沈无咎翻看训练记录，说我的____很稳定，这在新弟子中十分少见。
development:0.hook: Rain on the Cloud Sea Sect always came before a trial.
development:0.line: 'Your *development* is steady — do not let pride break that rhythm.'

later:0.en: Master Qingwu closed the lesson book and told me to rest. *Later*, when the hall was empty, I returned to the shelf where she had paused longest. The jade slip there was warm to the touch, as though someone had held it very recently, yet I had been the last one out.
later:0.cnHint: 师尊离开后，我____独自回到书架前，发现那枚玉简温热如刚被握过。
later:0.hook: Someone else had been in that empty hall.
later:0.line: 'Come back *later*, when the hall is quiet and your mind is still.'

maintain:0.en: The flame in the reading lamp must not waver, Xiaoxing reminded me. To *maintain* an even breath while reading was the first and hardest rule of the inner hall. I steadied myself, but in the polished bronze behind the lamp I caught a reflection that showed one more shadow than there were people in the room.
maintain:0.cnHint: 小星提醒我，阅览内堂的第一要义是____平稳的呼吸，但我在铜镜中看到了多余的影子。
maintain:0.line: '*Maintain* your breath, or the words on the slip will blur.'

traditional:0.en: Inside the Hall of Tested Blades, the stone walls held rows of carved characters — each one a word once spoken aloud to pass the entrance trial. Master Qingwu explained that the *traditional* method required every new disciple to write their chosen word in the air three times before the hall's silent judges. I raised my brush and breathed slowly.
traditional:0.cnHint: 在试剑台内，新弟子必须按____的方式，在空中书写自己选定的字。
traditional:0.hook: The third stroke hung in the air — and did not fade.
traditional:0.line: 'The *traditional* way is not old-fashioned — it is a test of sincerity,' said Master Qingwu.

expert:0.en: Shen Wujiu moved through the Hall of Tested Blades without hesitation, reading each carved word on the walls as though greeting old friends. An *expert* in the sect's oldest formulas, he could feel which characters still held spiritual warmth and which had gone cold with neglect. I watched his hands and tried to learn from the silence between his steps.
expert:0.cnHint: 师兄是研读古老字诀的____，他轻抚石壁上的刻字，感知其中灵气的冷暖。
expert:0.hook: He stopped at one character and said nothing for a long time.
expert:0.line: 'Even an *expert* bows before a word they have never truly heard,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

member:0.en: The hall keeper unrolled a narrow scroll and read each name aloud. When she reached mine, she paused. 'You are now a *member* of the Cloud Sea Sect,' she said, pressing a small jade token into my palm. The token was warm, as though it had been waiting. Around me, the carved words on the walls seemed to lean in closer.
member:0.cnHint: 典藏执事宣读名册，将玉牌交入我手，宣告我正式成为云海宗的____。
member:0.hook: The jade token pulsed once, then went still.
member:0.line: 'Every *member* of this sect carries one word that belongs only to them,' Xiaoxing whispered.

heart:0.en: Master Qingwu set a single character before me on the trial stone — one I did not recognise. She said that the *heart* of all cultivation was not power but attention: the ability to stay present with a word until the word trusted you. I placed my hand over the stone. Somewhere deep inside the mountain, something echoed back.
heart:0.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，修炼的____不在于力量，而在于能否静心守住一个字，直到它信任你。
heart:0.hook: The echo did not sound like my own heartbeat.
heart:0.line: 'If the *heart* is still, even a simple word can move the clouds,' said Master Qingwu.

within:0.en: The testing hall smelled of old wood and quiet power. Master Qingwu placed a single jade stone at the center of the floor. 'Shape the word HEAL,' she said, 'and keep its energy *within* this circle.' I breathed slowly, traced the letters in my mind, and felt warm light press against an invisible wall. It held.
within:0.cnHint: 师尊要求我将疗愈之词的灵力____一个圆圈内，不得溢出。
within:0.hook: But the stone cracked — and something beneath the floor answered.
within:0.line: 'Keep all your power *within* the circle, or the seal will break.'

either:0.en: Shen Wujiu set two scrolls on the table before me. One glowed pale blue, the other deep amber. 'You may not take *either* home tonight,' he said with a calm smile. 'Read them here, at this desk, and return both before the lamp goes out.' I nodded, already reaching for the blue one. The amber scroll trembled on its own.
either:0.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，两本卷轴我____不能带走，只能在此阅读。
either:0.hook: The amber scroll trembled on its own.
either:0.line: 'You cannot take *either* scroll — read them here and now.'

various:0.en: Along the inner wall of the testing hall hung *various* word-tablets: WIND, STONE, FIRE, MEND, RISE. Each tablet carried a different color of dust, left by disciples who had tried and failed. Xiaoxing pointed to the faintest one. 'That is RISE,' she whispered. 'No one has cleaned it in three years.' A single feather drifted down from the ceiling.
various:0.cnHint: 练剑台的墙上挂着____各样的词牌，记录着历代弟子的尝试。
various:0.hook: A single feather drifted down from the ceiling.
various:0.line: '*Various* word-tablets line this wall, each one a record of failure.'

main:0.en: Xiaoxing walked me through the hall before the trial began. 'The *main* thing to remember,' she said softly, 'is that a word spoken in fear will bend the wrong way.' She pressed a small warm stone into my hand — her own practice stone, worn smooth. The door to the inner chamber swung open by itself, though no wind moved.
main:0.cnHint: 师妹提醒我，在这次考验中____要的一点是不能带着恐惧念出灵词。
main:0.hook: The door to the inner chamber swung open by itself, though no wind moved.
main:0.line: 'The *main* thing is to speak without fear — fear bends every word.'

employee:0.en: An older man sat in the corner of the testing hall, copying records into a thick book. Shen Wujiu leaned close and murmured, 'He is not a disciple — he is an *employee* of the Sect, hired to keep the trial records honest.' I watched the man's brush move without pause. When I looked again, his page was blank, and he was watching me.
employee:0.cnHint: 师兄悄悄告诉我，坐在角落记录的那人是门派雇来的____，专职保证考试公正。
employee:0.hook: When I looked again, his page was blank, and he was watching me.
employee:0.line: 'That man is an *employee* of the Sect — he records every result faithfully.'

class:0.en: Master Qingwu gathered us in the small side room before the trial. 'This is not a ranked *class*,' she said. 'You are not competing against one another. You are each facing the word alone.' She paused, and the lanterns dimmed without anyone touching them. Outside, the clouds below the mountain rose higher than I had ever seen.
class:0.cnHint: 师尊说，这次集训不是分等级的____，我们每个人都要独自面对灵词考验。
class:0.hook: Outside, the clouds below the mountain rose higher than I had ever seen.
class:0.line: 'This is not a ranked *class* — each of you faces the word alone.'

behavior:0.en: After my trial, Shen Wujiu reviewed my result with a careful eye. 'Your score is fine,' he said, 'but Master Qingwu noticed your *behavior* near the amber tablet — the way you leaned toward it without meaning to.' I had not realized I moved at all. He closed the record book slowly and did not say what that leaning might mean.
behavior:0.cnHint: 师兄说，师尊留意到了我在琥珀词牌前无意识的____举动，并对此有所判断。
behavior:0.hook: He closed the record book slowly and did not say what that leaning might mean.
behavior:0.line: 'Your *behavior* near the amber tablet did not go unnoticed by Master Qingwu.'

disease:0.en: On the back wall of the hall hung an old chart of words used for healing. MEND and CLEAR sat at the top, but below them was a word I did not know. Xiaoxing touched it gently. 'That one treats *disease* of the spirit, not the body,' she said. 'No one in our generation has been able to pronounce it.' The word seemed to pulse once, slowly, like a second heartbeat.
disease:0.cnHint: 师妹告诉我，古老图表上有一个词专门用于治疗精神上的____，但我们这一代还没有人能念出它。
disease:0.hook: The word seemed to pulse once, slowly, like a second heartbeat.
disease:0.line: 'This word treats *disease* of the spirit — far harder to heal than the body.'

worker:0.en: The trial hall smelled of old stone and quiet effort. Along the walls, senior disciples carved word-seals into jade tablets, each one a *worker* shaping the sect's living library of spiritual formulas. I watched their chisels move and understood: mastery here was not given — it was cut, stroke by slow stroke. Then the nearest tablet cracked without warning.
worker:0.cnHint: 在试剑台的石室里，师兄们如同____般雕刻玉简，我看着他们的工作，忽然一块玉简无故裂开了。
worker:0.hook: The crack spread upward, and something cold breathed out from inside.
worker:0.line: 'A true *worker* of the word does not stop when the stone resists,' said Shen Wujiu.

control:0.en: Master Qingwu set a single candle before me and said nothing. The word for 'wind' hovered on my lips, full of eager power. I had to *control* its release — too fast and the flame would die, too slow and the word would burn me from within. I breathed, I steadied, the flame bent gently east. Then it bent back, all on its own.
control:0.cnHint: 在试剑台的烛火测试中，我努力____着口中灵词的力量，烛焰听话地偏转，却在片刻后自行复位。
control:0.hook: A flame that moves without wind is a warning no disciple ignores.
control:0.line: 'You must *control* the word before the word controls you,' Master Qingwu said softly.

product:0.en: Xiaoxing showed me her finished word-seal, pressed into a thin sheet of cloud-silk. 'Every seal is a *product* of every hour you spent in silence,' she said. Hers glowed a clean silver. Mine, beside it, pulsed an uncertain grey. We were shaped by the same lessons, yet the results stood as far apart as two mountains in separate skies. Then her seal flickered.
product:0.cnHint: 小星向我展示她完成的封印，说每一枚封印都是修炼时光的____，而我的封印与她相比黯然失色，随后她的封印突然闪烁。
product:0.hook: Silver light that flickers uninvited is never a good sign.
product:0.line: 'A seal is the *product* of silence, not of speed,' Xiaoxing said, glancing at mine.

practice:0.en: The trial hall required each new disciple to stand before the mirror-stone and speak the word for 'still.' It was a daily *practice*, simple in form but ruthless in judgment — the stone reflected not your face but your inner noise. I spoke, and the stone showed a boy tangled in too many fears. Shen Wujiu watched from the doorway, his own reflection perfectly calm. Then mine shifted.
practice:0.cnHint: 在试剑台，每日对镜石开口说'静'字是一项固定的____，镜中照出的是内心而非容貌，随后我的倒影开始变化。
practice:0.hook: A reflection that moves without you moving is asking a question.
practice:0.line: '*Practice* is the only herb that has no wrong dose,' Shen Wujiu said, turning away.

environment:0.en: Before a disciple could speak any word-formula, Master Qingwu insisted we understand the *environment* around us — the temperature of the stone floor, the direction of the upper wind, the mood of the cloud-sea far below. 'A word spoken in the wrong surroundings becomes a different word entirely,' she said. I looked around the trial hall and realized I had noticed none of these things. Outside, the cloud-sea turned a shade darker.
environment:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊要求我们在念出灵词之前先感知周围的____，我环顾试剑台才发现自己什么都没有留意，此时云海颜色悄然加深。
environment:0.hook: The cloud-sea does not darken without cause.
environment:0.line: 'Read the *environment* first,' Master Qingwu said, 'or the formula will read you.'

system:0.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a long scroll across the stone table, revealing the sect's word-training *system*: five tiers of formulas, each tier locked until the one below it was fully rooted in the body. It was a clear order, a patient ladder. I felt glad — until I saw my name already marked at tier two, skipping tier one entirely. No one had told me. The scroll trembled in a wind that was not there.
system:0.cnHint: 沈无咎展开记录门派修炼____的卷轴，我惊讶地发现自己的名字越过第一阶被标在第二阶，而此时卷轴在无风中颤动。
system:0.hook: Being placed higher than expected can mean someone expects you to fall.
system:0.line: 'The *system* exists so that no word takes root in hollow ground,' Shen Wujiu said.

natural:0.en: Xiaoxing told me that for most disciples, speaking a word-formula felt like lifting a heavy stone. For a few rare ones it was *natural*, as easy as breathing out on a cold morning. She watched me attempt the word for 'light' and tilted her head. 'You hold it like a stone,' she said, almost kindly. 'You should be breathing.' Above us, the ceiling lanterns dimmed all at once without being touched.
natural:0.cnHint: 小星告诉我，对少数弟子来说驾驭灵词如同呼吸一般____，而我却像搬石头，话音未落，头顶灯火同时黯淡。
natural:0.hook: Lanterns that dim together are listening to something you cannot hear.
natural:0.line: 'It should feel *natural*, like fog settling,' Xiaoxing said, watching the lanterns.

free:0.en: Master Qingwu placed her hand flat on the trial stone and the room went silent. 'A word held too tightly dies,' she said. 'You must let it be *free* inside you before it will do anything outside you.' I had been gripping every formula like something that might run away. I loosened my hold. The trial stone lit up — once, bright, then dark again. Somewhere deep in the mountain, a bell rang that no one had struck.
free:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊说，灵词必须在心中____流动才能发挥作用，试剑台的试炼石随即一亮又暗，山腹深处无人敲响的钟声悠然响起。
free:0.hook: An unrung bell is the mountain's way of saying it has heard you.
free:0.line: 'Let the word be *free*, or it will never leave your mouth as power,' said Master Qingwu.

compare:1.en: At the Trial Sword Platform, Master Qingwu lined up our spirit-word tablets side by side. 'Do not *compare* your blade with another's,' she said, 'or you will chase their path and lose your own.' I looked at my tablet. Its glow was faint — but it was mine alone.
compare:1.cnHint: 师尊在试剑台上提醒弟子，不要把自己的灵字和别人____，应走自己的道路。
compare:1.hook: A crack split my tablet down the middle at dusk.
compare:1.line: 'Do not *compare* your light to Shen Wujiu's — yours burns differently.'

past:1.en: The Trial Sword Platform is carved from stone older than the Cloud Sea Sect itself. Shen Wujiu knelt there and pressed one palm to the rock. 'The *past* is sealed inside,' he whispered. 'Every disciple who failed here left a word behind.' Beneath my feet, a faint pulse answered.
past:1.cnHint: 师兄在试剑台古石上感受到，许多前辈弟子的____都封存在这块石头之中。
past:1.hook: The pulse grew stronger the moment I stepped forward.
past:1.line: 'The *past* of this platform holds more words than any scroll in the sect.'

suffer:1.en: Rain came sideways across the Trial Sword Platform. Xiaoxing stood firm, her hair flat against her face. Those who could not hold their spirit-word in the storm were sent inside. I chose to *suffer* the cold wind rather than retreat, and by the time the rain stopped, my word burned white.
suffer:1.cnHint: 小星和我在试剑台上宁愿____风雨，也不愿退进室内，坚持到底。
suffer:1.hook: A second storm was already forming on the eastern ridge.
suffer:1.line: 'I will *suffer* the rain — my word is not strong enough to protect itself yet.'

almost:1.en: My spirit-word lifted me three feet off the Trial Sword Platform — then *almost* dropped me into the clouds below. I grabbed a stone post with both hands, heart loud in my ears. Shen Wujiu did not laugh. He only said, 'Good. Fear means you felt the height.'
almost:1.cnHint: 我在试剑台上用灵字飞起三尺，却____坠入云海，幸好抓住了石柱。
almost:1.hook: Below the platform, something large moved beneath the clouds.
almost:1.line: 'You *almost* had it — one more breath of intent and the word will hold you.'

especially:1.en: Every new disciple must speak their spirit-word aloud at the Trial Sword Platform. The stone tests sincerity, *especially* in those who recite without feeling. Xiaoxing's voice was soft, but the platform lit up gold. Mine was loud, and the stone gave only a pale flicker.
especially:1.cnHint: 试剑台的石台会考验弟子的诚心，____是那些有口无心地念诵灵字的人。
especially:1.hook: The pale flicker pulsed once — then went out entirely.
especially:1.line: 'The platform is harsh with everyone, *especially* those who shout instead of meaning it.'

publish:1.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a long banner at the edge of the Trial Sword Platform and smoothed it flat. 'Today I *publish* the names of those whose words have passed the first trial,' she said. The wind held still. Shen Wujiu's name was first. Mine was not yet there.
publish:1.cnHint: 师尊在试剑台边展开长幡，____通过初试的弟子名单，我的名字还没在上面。
publish:1.hook: At the bottom of the banner, a name appeared without ink.
publish:1.line: 'I will *publish* the results at noon — those absent will be considered withdrawn.'

activity:1.en: By dawn the Trial Sword Platform was already full of noise and motion. 'This *activity* starts before the sun does,' Xiaoxing said, rubbing her eyes. Each station tested a different word: one for healing, one for speed, one for flight. I moved between them, unsure which was meant for me.
activity:1.cnHint: 试剑台上清晨就开始了热闹的____，每个考站测试不同的灵字能力。
activity:1.hook: One station stood empty, its testing stone turned dark as ink.
activity:1.line: 'This *activity* will decide which path each of us walks for the next three years.'

science:1.en: 'Word-craft is not only art,' Master Qingwu told us at the Trial Sword Platform, her robe still in the windless cold. 'It is a *science* — measure, test, refine. Feel alone will not carry you past the first cloud ridge.' I wrote the word down and stared at it for a long time.
science:1.cnHint: 师尊在试剑台教导我们，灵字修炼不只是艺术，更是一门____，需要测量和验证。
science:1.hook: From the cloud ridge, a single black feather drifted down to my feet.
science:1.line: 'Treat word-craft as a *science* — record every result and learn from every failure.'

contribute:1.en: On the Trial Sword Platform, each disciple was asked to carve one word-herb into the shared stone pillar. 'Even a single word can *contribute* to the sect's strength,' Master Qingwu said, pressing my hand gently to the cold stone. I carved 'still.' The pillar glowed faint gold and did not stop.
contribute:1.cnHint: 在试剑台，弟子们被要求将各自的词草____到宗门的石柱上。
contribute:1.hook: By midnight, the pillar's glow had spread to the clouds below.
contribute:1.line: 'Every disciple must *contribute* one true word before the season turns.'

share:1.en: Shen Wujiu split his last word-herb into three equal pieces on the edge of the Trial Sword Platform and held one out to me. 'Take your *share*,' he said simply. Below us the cloud sea shifted like a slow breath. I took the piece; it tasted of pine and something older.
share:1.cnHint: 在试剑台边缘，师兄将最后一枚词草分开，把____递给了我。
share:1.hook: The clouds below parted, revealing a shadow that had no owner.
share:1.line: 'Take your *share* — we carry the same sky tonight.'

decade:1.en: The Trial Sword Platform had stood for a *decade* of decades, its stone worn smooth by ten thousand bare feet before mine. Master Qingwu traced one deep groove with her finger. 'Each mark,' she said, 'is a word someone almost said.' The wind agreed by going very quiet.
decade:1.cnHint: 试剑台已矗立了数个____，台石被无数弟子的脚步磨得光滑。
decade:1.hook: In the newest groove, fresh and bright, my name had already been carved.
decade:1.line: 'A *decade* is nothing — some words take a century to ripen.'

kind:1.en: On the Trial Sword Platform, the word-herbs fell into two groups: those that burned and those that healed. 'What *kind* do you reach for first?' Master Qingwu asked, watching my hand hover. I chose the pale green one, the one that smelled of rain. She nodded and said nothing more.
kind:1.cnHint: 在试剑台，师尊问我倾向于哪种____的词草——焚烧的还是治愈的。
kind:1.hook: The herb I chose dissolved and left a character on my palm I could not read.
kind:1.line: 'The *kind* of word you love most will shape every path you walk.'

across:1.en: Master Qingwu drew a single character in the air and sent it *across* the full width of the Trial Sword Platform. It passed every disciple in turn, pausing at each face like a question. When it reached me it stopped, turned slowly, and waited. No one had seen it stop before.
across:1.cnHint: 师尊将一个字符送____整个试剑台，它在每位弟子面前短暂停留。
across:1.hook: The character was still turning when the platform bell rang on its own.
across:1.line: 'Send your word *across* the platform — let the stone decide if it is true.'

factor:1.en: Shen Wujiu marked the results on a flat stone after the trial: speed, clarity, intent. 'Courage is the hidden *factor*,' he told Xiaoxing and me, tapping the last column he had left blank on purpose. Far below, something large moved once through the cloud sea and was still again.
factor:1.cnHint: 师兄将试炼结果逐项记录，指出勇气是被众人忽视的____。
factor:1.hook: The blank column began to fill with characters none of us had written.
factor:1.line: 'Courage is the one *factor* the stone measures without being asked.'

condition:1.en: Xiaoxing checked the Trial Sword Platform before dawn, running her fingers along each crack. 'The *condition* of the stone tells you the mood of the mountain,' she whispered to me. One crack near the center was warm to the touch. By the time we told Master Qingwu, the crack had sealed itself.
condition:1.cnHint: 小星在黎明前检查试剑台，说石台的____能反映山脉的情绪。
condition:1.hook: Where the crack had been, a single unfamiliar word now pressed up from below.
condition:1.line: 'The *condition* of the platform changes when the clouds hold their breath.'

effort:1.en: My first word-herb shattered the moment I released it above the Trial Sword Platform. Shen Wujiu watched without pity. 'The *effort* shows,' he said, and that was all. I tried again. The second herb held its shape for three full breaths before it drifted down into the cloud sea and was gone.
effort:1.cnHint: 我在试剑台上第一次释放词草时它碎了，师兄说他看见了我的____。
effort:1.hook: From deep in the cloud sea, my shattered herb glowed back up at me like an answer.
effort:1.line: 'The *effort* you put in — the mountain puts back. It forgets nothing.'

receive:1.en: At the base of Trial Sword Platform, a messenger crane landed on my shoulder and dropped a folded leaf into my palm. I had come to *receive* my first formal task from the sect — a herb-collecting mission on the outer peaks. The crane lifted away before I could even bow.
receive:1.cnHint: 我在试剑台下____了宗门交给我的第一份任务。
receive:1.hook: The leaf bore a second message, written in fading ink.
receive:1.line: 'You will *receive* your answer only after the trial begins.'

encourage:1.en: Shen Wujiu stood beside me at the foot of the platform stairs, watching younger disciples hesitate at the first stone step. He placed a steady hand on my shoulder. 'The mountain will not move for fear,' he said, meaning to *encourage* me before I climbed alone into the cold morning mist.
encourage:1.cnHint: 师兄在试剑台前____我踏上石阶，不要因恐惧而退缩。
encourage:1.hook: Above the mist, something vast and silent was already watching.
encourage:1.line: 'I say this to *encourage* you — the platform remembers courage.'

travel:1.en: The road to Trial Sword Platform wound between two cliffs where wind moved like a living thing. Our *travel* that morning was slow; each step pressed spirit energy down into the stone path, as the sect rules required. Xiaoxing counted her breaths aloud to keep pace with the rhythm of the mountain.
travel:1.cnHint: 我们去往试剑台的____十分缓慢，每一步都要将灵力注入石路。
travel:1.hook: At the last bend, the path simply ended in open sky.
travel:1.line: 'Every *travel* to this place is a test before the test.'

strong:1.en: Master Qingwu walked the outer edge of Trial Sword Platform without looking down. The boards were old, yet her steps did not waver. 'The wood is *strong*,' she said, 'because ten thousand disciples have crossed it and none have doubted it.' I gripped the railing and tried to believe the same.
strong:1.cnHint: 师尊说，试剑台的木板因无数弟子的信念而变得____。
strong:1.hook: Then one board beneath my foot gave a low, warning crack.
strong:1.line: 'Only a *strong* heart keeps these old planks from breaking.'

chance:1.en: Shen Wujiu told me that the sect opens Trial Sword Platform only once each season. A single *chance* — that was all any disciple would receive to prove their word-craft before Master Qingwu and the assembly of elders. The wind above the platform carried the distant sound of a bell no one had rung.
chance:1.cnHint: 试剑台每季只开放一次，这是弟子展示功法的唯一____。
chance:1.hook: A second bell answered from somewhere far below the clouds.
chance:1.line: 'Do not waste the one *chance* the platform gives you.'

solve:1.en: A stone tablet stood at the entrance to Trial Sword Platform, carved with a formula no disciple had read aloud correctly in three years. Xiaoxing pressed her fingertips to the cold surface and closed her eyes. I watched her lips move, certain she was the first among us who might truly *solve* it.
solve:1.cnHint: 小星闭上眼睛，试图____试剑台入口石碑上三年无人破解的法文。
solve:1.hook: When she opened her eyes, the carved letters were gone.
solve:1.line: 'To *solve* the tablet is to open a door you cannot close.'

quite:1.en: I had expected Trial Sword Platform to be loud with wind and contest. Instead the air was *quite* still — so still that I could hear the soft creak of the floating mountain shifting beneath us. Master Qingwu said nothing. She simply looked at the horizon, as if waiting for something only she could see.
quite:1.cnHint: 试剑台上出乎意料地____寂静，连浮山的轻微移动都听得见。
quite:1.hook: That stillness broke with a sound like tearing silk.
quite:1.line: 'It is *quite* calm now — that is when you must be most alert.'

technology:1.en: An elder from the Archive Hall unrolled a long scroll beside the platform's central pillar. It mapped every known word-formula the sect had gathered over two hundred years — their highest *technology* of spirit and language, distilled into ink that shimmered faintly even under cloud-filtered light. I had never seen so many words in one place.
technology:1.cnHint: 典藏堂的长老展示了宗门两百年积累的灵文____精华卷轴。
technology:1.hook: One formula at the scroll's edge had been crossed out in red.
technology:1.line: 'This *technology* of words is the only weapon that truly lasts.'

education:1.en: On the Trial Sword Platform, Master Qingwu gathered every new disciple beneath the open sky. 'Your *education* begins not with a blade,' she said, 'but with the living herbs beneath your feet.' She pressed one leaf into my palm. Its warmth moved upward like a slow green fire.
education:1.cnHint: 在试剑台上，师尊告诉弟子们，真正的____从脚下的灵草开始。
education:1.hook: The leaf's warmth reached my wrist and would not stop.
education:1.line: 'Your *education* begins not with a blade, but with the earth.'

scientist:1.en: Shen Wujiu stood apart from the other disciples, studying the platform's stone carvings with quiet eyes. The older disciples called him a *scientist* of spiritual formulae, one who measured every herb's effect before he trusted it. I watched him press two fingers to a carved line and count beneath his breath.
scientist:1.cnHint: 师兄像研究灵纹的____一样，冷静地丈量着试剑台上的每一道刻痕。
scientist:1.hook: When he finished counting, his fingers left a faint glow behind.
scientist:1.line: 'A *scientist* of the formulae trusts the measure, not the legend.'

physical:1.en: The Trial Sword Platform rose above the cloud sea on a single column of bare rock. Master Qingwu warned us that the *physical* weight of doubt could pull a disciple off the edge faster than any wind. I felt my knees soften and gripped the stone railing with both hands.
physical:1.cnHint: 师尊警告说，内心的疑惑会化作____的重量，将弟子拖离试剑台。
physical:1.hook: A small cloud drifted through the railing, and I felt it press against my palm.
physical:1.line: 'The *physical* weight of doubt is heavier than iron.'

quality:1.en: Xiaoxing handed me a pale blue herb and said its *quality* could be judged by the pattern of light it made against the morning sky. She lifted it slowly, and three rings of soft gold appeared, perfectly spaced. I raised mine. Only one ring appeared, and it trembled.
quality:1.cnHint: 师妹教我对着晨光检验灵草的____，我的灵草只现出一道摇晃的光环。
quality:1.hook: The trembling ring faded before I could count its colour.
quality:1.line: 'The *quality* of a herb speaks in light, not in words.'

habit:1.en: Every dawn on the Trial Sword Platform, Shen Wujiu swept the stone floor before anyone else arrived. Master Qingwu once told me this quiet *habit* had kept his spiritual energy clear for three full seasons. I began to rise earlier, broom in hand, hoping the same calm would find me.
habit:1.cnHint: 师兄每天清晨打扫试剑台的____，据说令他三季以来灵气清明。
habit:1.hook: On the third morning, my broom struck something beneath a loose stone.
habit:1.line: 'This small *habit* has guarded my spirit longer than any sword.'

sound:1.en: A deep *sound* rose from the platform's centre stone as dawn touched it — steady, like a bell held underwater. Xiaoxing said the stone only sang when the cloud sea below was rising. We all turned and looked over the edge. The white clouds were climbing, fast and silent.
sound:1.cnHint: 试剑台中央的石台发出低沉的____，师妹说这意味着云海正在上涌。
sound:1.hook: The clouds reached the platform's edge and kept climbing.
sound:1.line: 'That *sound* means the cloud sea remembers it is alive.'

average:1.en: Master Qingwu looked at my first practice strike and said nothing for a long moment. Then she told me my form was *average* — steady enough to pass, too careful to grow. She set a single stone leaf spinning in the air and asked me to cut it without slowing my breath.
average:1.cnHint: 师尊说我的剑姿只是____水平，并用一片旋转的石叶来考验我是否能突破自己。
average:1.hook: The leaf spun faster the moment my sword moved toward it.
average:1.line: '*Average* is the place you pass through, not the place you rest.'

body:1.en: Before the trial began, Shen Wujiu told me to feel the platform as an extension of my own *body* — every crack in the stone a joint, every carved line a vein. I pressed my bare foot to the centre stone and felt something slow and deep move upward through my leg.
body:1.cnHint: 师兄要我把试剑台当作自己____的延伸，感受石台中流动的灵脉。
body:1.hook: What moved through my leg did not feel like stone.
body:1.line: 'Let the platform become your *body*, and the stone will guide you.'

personal:1.en: The Trial Sword Platform stood open to the sky, swept by mountain winds. Each disciple carved one word into the stone before stepping forward. 'This is not a group test,' Shen Wujiu said quietly beside me. 'Your bond with a word is *personal* — no one else can feel it for you.' I pressed my palm to the cold stone and breathed.
personal:1.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，每个人与词语之间的____联系，旁人无法代替感受。
personal:1.hook: The stone grew warm beneath my hand, and then began to glow.
personal:1.line: 'Your bond with a word is *personal* — no one else can feel it for you.'

rather:1.en: Master Qingwu stood at the edge of the platform, her robes still in the heavy wind. She did not call my name loudly. She spoke it *rather* softly, the way one speaks a word one respects. I walked forward anyway, heart loud in my chest, the clouds far below swallowing all sound of the world beneath.
rather:1.cnHint: 师尊____轻声念出我的名字，语气中带着一种令人敬畏的分量。
rather:1.hook: Below the platform, the sea of clouds parted — just once, just briefly.
rather:1.line: 'I call your name *rather* softly because a name deserves that respect.'

instead:1.en: I had chosen the word 'rise' to carve into the trial stone. But when my hand touched the surface, my fingers moved on their own and wrote 'hold' *instead*. Shen Wujiu said nothing. Xiaoxing drew a quiet breath. The wind across the platform dropped to a hush, as if the mountain itself was listening.
instead:1.cnHint: 我本想刻下一个词，手却自行刻下了另一个词____。
instead:1.hook: The word 'hold' shone silver, then sank into the stone without a trace.
instead:1.line: 'Your hand wrote 'hold' *instead* — trust what it knew.'

performance:1.en: The senior disciples lined the edges of the Trial Sword Platform to watch. Xiaoxing whispered that this was not about impressing anyone. Yet every disciple's *performance* here became part of the Sect's living record — a page no one could erase. I steadied my breath, lifted my brush, and let the first word rise from my chest like smoke.
performance:1.cnHint: 在试剑台上，每位弟子的____都会被记入门派的永久档案。
performance:1.hook: When my word left the brush, it hung in the air and refused to fall.
performance:1.line: 'Your *performance* here writes one page that will never be erased.'

percent:1.en: Master Qingwu told us that most disciples use only thirty *percent* of a word's true meaning when they first speak it aloud on the platform. I thought of all the weight still sleeping inside the words I had studied. The wind rose, and somewhere below the clouds a bell rang once — slow, low, final.
percent:1.cnHint: 师尊说，弟子初次开口时，往往只能用出词语真义的____之三十。
percent:1.hook: I decided, quietly, that thirty percent would not be enough for me.
percent:1.line: 'Most disciples use thirty *percent* of a word's power on their first try.'

achieve:1.en: Xiaoxing had failed the platform trial twice before. Today she stood at the stone circle with her eyes closed for a long moment, then spoke her word clearly into the open sky. To *achieve* that calm — after two failures, with every eye watching — seemed to me the hardest thing I had ever seen anyone do. The clouds below brightened as if in answer.
achieve:1.cnHint: 师妹在两次失败后终于____了那种平静，令我深感震撼。
achieve:1.hook: Her word rose, steadied, and carved itself into the air above the platform.
achieve:1.line: 'To *achieve* calm after two failures — that is the real trial.'

challenge:1.en: Shen Wujiu approached the centre stone last among the senior disciples. He turned to face us, the younger ones, before he began. 'A word is not a weapon you pick up,' he said. 'It is a *challenge* you accept, every single time you speak it.' Then he pressed both hands flat to the stone, and the whole platform hummed.
challenge:1.cnHint: 师兄说，每一次开口说出一个词，都是在接受一次____。
challenge:1.hook: The hum spread from the stone into our feet, and none of us moved.
challenge:1.line: 'A word is a *challenge* you accept every single time you speak it.'

power:1.en: When my turn came, I stepped onto the cold centre stone. I had one word ready. I spoke it plainly, without force. The *power* did not come from how loudly I said it — it rose from the silence I had kept before I spoke, the way a held breath gives weight to the first note of a song. Clouds curled upward beneath the platform's edge.
power:1.cnHint: 我意识到词语的____并非来自音量，而是来自开口前的那份沉默。
power:1.hook: A single white feather drifted up from the clouds and came to rest at my feet.
power:1.line: 'The *power* of a word lives in the silence before you speak it.'

nearly:1.en: The trial platform floated high above the sea of clouds, its stone surface worn smooth by a hundred years of disciples. I stepped forward to speak the first word-formula, but my breath *nearly* failed me — the wind at this height cut through every layer of cloth. Shen Wujiu stood at the edge, calm as still water, watching.
nearly:1.cnHint: 弟子踏上试剑台，高处寒风让他____无法开口念出第一个字诀。
nearly:1.hook: Below the platform, one cloud had turned the colour of ink.
nearly:1.line: 'You *nearly* dropped the formula — hold the breath first, then the word.'

wrong:1.en: Master Qingwu drew a single word-formula in the air above the trial platform. She asked me to copy it. My hand moved with confidence, but the light that answered was pale and thin. She said nothing — only pointed to one stroke I had shaped *wrong*. A small error, yet the whole formula had lost its power.
wrong:1.cnHint: 师尊指出弟子在试剑台上写下的字诀有一笔____，导致法力尽失。
wrong:1.hook: The pale light drifted downward and vanished into the clouds.
wrong:1.line: 'That one stroke is *wrong* — and one wrong stroke can cost you everything up here.'

variety:1.en: The trial platform held a wide *variety* of carved stones, each etched with a different word-formula — some for healing, some for lifting wind, some for drawing fire. Xiaoxing moved between them like a butterfly, touching each one lightly. I stood still, not knowing where to begin.
variety:1.cnHint: 试剑台上刻有____各异的字诀石碑，师妹轻松穿行其间，弟子却不知从何入手。
variety:1.hook: One stone at the far end glowed faintly, though no disciple had touched it.
variety:1.line: 'The *variety* here is a test — master one kind deeply before you reach for another.'

clear:1.en: I had been struggling with the wind-formula for an hour when Shen Wujiu crouched beside me on the trial platform and spoke each syllable slowly. Suddenly the meaning was *clear* — the word was not a command to the wind, but a request. I tried once more, and the air answered.
clear:1.cnHint: 师兄在试剑台上缓缓示范，弟子终于____地理解了风之字诀的真意。
clear:1.hook: At that moment the clouds below parted, revealing a shadow shaped like a hand.
clear:1.line: 'Now it is *clear* to you — the wind has never obeyed force, only courtesy.'

gain:1.en: At the end of the trial, Master Qingwu reviewed each disciple in silence. When she reached me, she said that today's *gain* was small but honest — I had learned to feel the shape of a formula before speaking it aloud. I bowed, trying to hide the pride warming my chest.
gain:1.cnHint: 试炼结束，师尊评价弟子今日虽____不多，却学会了感受字诀的形状。
gain:1.hook: She turned away, and for one breath her shadow stretched twice her height.
gain:1.line: 'A small *gain* on the platform today is worth more than a great claim at the desk.'

maybe:1.en: The stone beneath my feet hummed when I spoke the formula — a sound I had never caused before. Xiaoxing looked over with wide eyes. I did not know whether I had done something right or something dangerous. *Maybe* both, I thought, and held very still while the hum slowly faded.
maybe:1.cnHint: 弟子念出字诀后台石发出震鸣，他心想____是对的，____也是危险的。
maybe:1.hook: The hum did not fully fade — it dropped into the rock and kept moving.

huge:1.en: When Shen Wujiu demonstrated the full storm-formula on the trial platform, the sound that followed was *huge* — a deep roll that shook the mountain and sent a ring of clouds spinning outward below us. He stepped back, breathing evenly, as though he had done nothing remarkable at all.
huge:1.cnHint: 师兄在试剑台上演示风暴字诀，发出____的轰鸣，震动了整座浮山。
huge:1.hook: The spinning ring of clouds slowed, then began to rise.
huge:1.line: 'The sound is *huge*, yes — but listen past it for the small silence inside.'

diet:1.en: Before the trial, Xiaoxing reminded me that a disciple's *diet* on testing days should be light — heavy food weighs the breath and blurs the tongue. I had eaten well that morning and already felt the difference: each formula came out half a beat too slow. She had been right.
diet:1.cnHint: 试炼前师妹提醒弟子，测试日的____要清淡，否则吐字会迟缓。
diet:1.hook: A thin mist rose from the platform stones, smelling of cold pine.
diet:1.line: 'Watch your *diet* before a trial — a heavy meal is the first word spoken wrong.'

animal:1.en: On the Trial Sword Stage, a carved stone *animal* crouched at each corner — four beasts, each facing a different wind. Master Qingwu told us they were not decoration. 'They listen,' she said, 'for disciples whose hearts are not yet clean.' I felt their hollow eyes turn toward me.
animal:1.cnHint: 试剑台四角各有一只石雕____，师尊说它们会聆听弟子的内心。
animal:1.hook: One stone eye had shifted since morning.
animal:1.line: 'Every *animal* here was once a failed disciple, so I am told.'

goal:1.en: Shen Wujiu drew his sword in a single breath and struck three targets before the incense burned down. 'What is your *goal* today?' he asked me, sheathing the blade without looking. I had no answer ready. The targets still swayed, and the crowd on the lower path had gone very quiet.
goal:1.cnHint: 师兄问我今日上台的____是什么，我却一时语塞。
goal:1.hook: The swaying targets cast shadows shaped like question marks.
goal:1.line: 'A disciple without a *goal* is a blade without an edge.'

adult:1.en: I had expected the Trial Sword Stage to be filled with older students, but even the youngest *adult* here moved with a stillness I had not yet learned. Master Qingwu watched from the pavilion above, her sleeves unmoving in the wind, as though she herself were part of the mountain.
adult:1.cnHint: 台上每一位____弟子都身姿沉稳，让初来的我自叹不如。
adult:1.hook: Master Qingwu's eyes had not blinked once.
adult:1.line: 'Even the newest *adult* disciple has chosen a path — have you?'

poor:1.en: Xiaoxing missed the third target and stepped back with a quiet sigh. 'My footwork is still *poor*,' she said, not to anyone in particular, pressing one hand flat against her chest as though steadying something inside. A single cloud passed beneath the stage, and for a moment the whole platform felt untethered.
